warnings.headline: Strong wind gusts, yellow level, Parts of Finnmark, 2026-10-19T07:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-20T06:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: Locally strong wind gusts around 27-33 m/s are expected from west, and severe gale force 9 to storm force 10 at the coast. The wind will increase first in west, and decrease last in the east.
warnings.instruction: Secure loose objects: Consider taking precautions to prevent damage before the event occurs. Avoid unnecessary travel in exposed areas. Risk of traffic obstructions: Check road reports on vegvesen.no/trafikk.
